Name: The Marshlands
Description: Wet and green. Reed grows thick here and something is always moving in it.

Name: The Cinder Wastes
Description: Ash underfoot and heat in the air. Nothing grows but the fires do.

Name: The Hollowdeep
Description: Below the old works. The dark down here has weight to it.

Name: The Frostreach
Description: White over blue, and the wind never stops. An example of how a biome changes with four colours.
